name: Storyfold
message: The editor and Catalyst panel are running. Browser sample/export flow and 15 core tests passed; the six-second portrait render proves a one-second L-cut. Finishing upload checks, documentation and Git review/undo acceptance.

tasks.title: Make the build visible
tasks.acceptance: Architecture and schema committed; progress, task edits, source review and undo available in Catalyst.

tasks.title: Edit an interview by sentences
tasks.acceptance: Topic folders, sentence selection, live groups, reorder, trims, camera selection, L-cuts, skip, undo and persisted autosave work.

tasks.title: Process and export real media
tasks.acceptance: Upload and timed transcript or word-timestamp transcription; ffmpeg proxies, peaks and MP4; SRT, EDL and FCPXML downloads.

tasks.title: Verify the complete local flow
tasks.acceptance: Typecheck, lint, unit and integration tests, browser acceptance and probed ffmpeg render pass.

tasks.title: Validate your sample interview
tasks.acceptance: 20-sentence accuracy/timing audit, camera clap alignment and NLE import checked using the supplied real interview.

tasks.title: Package the desktop app
tasks.acceptance: Windows and Ubuntu installers and CI; native folder picker and keychain support.

tasks.title: Connect publishing and site care
tasks.acceptance: Configured deployment, preflight, rollback, host adapters, CLI/MCP and backups verified.
